title: Task Schema
description: Structured phase/step schema for a dispatched task. Generated by the orchestrator LLM from the markdown template at dispatch time. Used by the gateway to parse TASK.md into structured progress.

flowType.description: The dispatch flow type that created this task.

title.description: Human-readable task title, typically from the ticket summary or PR title.

totalSteps.description: Total number of steps across all phases. Must equal the sum of all phase step counts.

phases.description: Ordered list of phases extracted from ### section headers in the template.

phase.description: A task phase corresponding to a ### section in the markdown template.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps within this phase, extracted from numbered checkboxes.

step.description: A single task step corresponding to a `- [ ] **N. ...` checkbox in the template.

index.description: 1-based step number, globally unique across all phases. Matches the numbered checkbox in TASK.md.

name.description: Step name from the checkbox text (e.g., 'Run lint:tsc', 'Record before.mp4').

artifacts.description: Expected artifacts produced by this step. Used by the monitor to verify step completion.
